title: Belair National Park
get_in:
[[File:Belair Line diagram.png|thumb|300px|The Belair Line from the CBD]]
From Adelaide [[Adelaide/City and North Adelaide|City]] head down south onto Unley Road. Follow that road and onto B29 until Lafers Road, where you'll then need to turn left. Once you've turned left, continue straight and then turn right and left until you're at the park.

There are frequent [https://www.adelaidemetro.com.au/routes/bel '''trains'''] between Adelaide city and Belair Railway Station at the North-Western corner of the park. The full journey takes about 40min. Trains operate from early morning to late at night everyday including public holidays. Bikes can be taken on the train (for free on weekends and Monday to Friday between 9:01AM to 3PM and after 6PM).
